changes: Fixed the pipeline aborting and reconnecting in a loop for SRT sources whose frame rate is not declared: the preview branch no longer relies on videorate, which hard-fails on frames that carry no duration.
Fixed HEVC/H.265 Live Preview by decoding the continuous reference-frame sequence and rejecting decoder-marked corrupt frames.
Prevented preview queue from dropping compressed MPEG-TS packets before demux and decode; retained existing AVC/H.264 thumbnail behavior.
Signed update bundles now carry a verified updater helper so retained-release rollback support stays current.
